meta.name: Slit Velocity
meta.notes: Near-black field where --c-primary is the only live colour (prices on hover, cart count, active filter, scroll meter, slit-scan edge glow); very dark primaries are lifted toward white for text use, --c-accent is only a tiny tag dot.

issues: Product frames: white-background packshots render as hard white rectangles of different sizes floating in the dark frames, which looks like a broken catalogue, not a studio shoot (creativity 6, polish 5)

Hero headline only fills about 60% of the left column at desktop; the brief asks for a towering condensed headline the full viewport height, but it reads as an ordinary H1 with dead space under it (typography 6)
The '+1' cart toast stays visible as a stray red tab on the right edge (below the fold and in full-page captures) on both pages (polish)
Gallery reel with only 2 photos (stress brand) leaves a large empty grey slab where the third frame should be (layout 5 on stress)
The red-shift tear lines use 'lighter', which would disappear on any pale product surface
Mobile is solid; brand-colour robustness is good thanks to the --c-live lift (7); feels less generic than most, but the product grid let it down
fixed: Added a uniform cool-grey studio plate (radial sweep, inset 8%) behind every contained packshot, with mix-blend-mode multiply so white shop backgrounds melt into it. The plate is also painted into the slit-scan base canvas, so the whole lightbox tears into strips at speed and snaps back
Red-shift edges switch to a multiply tint on plates (lighter stays on full-bleed photos), so the tear lines stay visible in every frame
Hero headline is fitted by JS (binary search) to the full available column height without breaking words, so it really towers on desktop; mobile keeps the CSS size
Toast is hidden with opacity and visibility when idle, so no stray '+1' tab on either page
Gallery frames grow to fill the row at a fixed height, so 2–3 photos make a full-width cinematic strip instead of leaving an empty slab
Hero pick thumbnail uses the same plate and multiply treatment for consistency
